page.overview:
Who is Sheriff Terry?

Terry is a local sheriff in a small town in Kansas.

In Dreadnoks Rising, the Joes come to the town only to discover that it overrun by the biker gang the Dreadnoks led by Zartan. Clearly intimidated by the gang's actions, Sheriff Terry would only do the bare minimum to deter them. Eventually, the Joes took the fight to the Dreadnoks inspiring the the rest of the town to stand up for themselves. Terry ended up beating Zartan and arresting him. As thanks for helping to rid the town of the Dreadnoks, Sheriff Terry let the Joes escape before Flint arrived.

Category:Male Characters Category:Renegades Characters
